note: Gyms ClawBack can check visits for and help cancel. Only studios listed here get a cancellation email sent to the studio; any other gym gets Copy and send-to-yourself. The demo studio's email is a test address, never a real studio.

cancel.how: Orangetheory studios ask for 30 days' written notice to cancel. Email to your home studio is the usual way to give it; check your membership agreement.
